#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Ignored synthetic real-CLI saved-settings matrix; never uses user preferences."""
from __future__ import annotations
import argparse
import datetime as dt
import hashlib
import importlib.util
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import platform
import re
import shutil
import subprocess
import sys


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("--ffmpeg", type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--ffprobe", type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--output", type=Path, required=True)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    repo = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
    modules = []
    helpers_paths = [repo / "scripts/Test-MeasuredLoudness.py", repo / "scripts/Test-GentleCleaning.py"]
    for index, path in enumerate(helpers_paths):
        spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("settings_media_helper_" + str(index), path)
        module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
        previous = sys.dont_write_bytecode
        try:
            sys.dont_write_bytecode = True
            spec.loader.exec_module(module)
        finally:
            sys.dont_write_bytecode = previous
        modules.append(module)
    helpers, common = modules
    sha256 = helpers.sha256
    ffmpeg, ffprobe = args.ffmpeg.resolve(strict=True), args.ffprobe.resolve(strict=True)
    output = args.output.resolve()
    if not output.is_relative_to((repo / ".wac-local/WAC-M3-01").resolve()):
        parser.error("Output must be under the ignored M3-01 scratch directory")
    output.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=False)
    for folder in ("app", "fixtures", "configs", "captures", "logs", "references"):
        (output / folder).mkdir()
    source_paths = [repo / name for name in ("WinAudioClean.ps1", "WinAudioClean.IO.ps1", "WinAudioClean.Preview.ps1", "WinAudioClean.Settings.ps1")]
    source_paths += [*helpers_paths, repo / "docs/codex/winaudioclean/BASELINE.json", Path(__file__).resolve()]
    clean_env = {key: value for key, value in os.environ.items() if key.upper() != "PSMODULEPATH"}

    def sanitize(value):
        if isinstance(value, str):
            for original, replacement in ((str(repo), "<repo>"), (str(Path.home()), "<user-profile>")):
                for variant in (original, original.replace("\\", "/"), original.replace("\\", "\\\\")):
                    value = re.sub(re.escape(variant), lambda match: replacement, value, flags=re.IGNORECASE)
            return value
        if isinstance(value, dict):
            return {key: sanitize(item) for key, item in value.items()}
        if isinstance(value, list):
            return [sanitize(item) for item in value]
        return value

    def source_hashes():
        return {path.relative_to(repo).as_posix(): sha256(path) for path in source_paths}

    def file_record(path):
        return {"path": str(path.relative_to(repo)), "sha256": sha256(path), "bytes": path.stat().st_size}

    summary = {"task": "WAC-M3-01", "created_utc": dt.datetime.now(dt.timezone.utc).isoformat(),
               "notice": "Synthetic settings/CLI/PCM mechanics only. No user settings, speech listening, cross-build or hardware-failure durability proof.",
               "source_revision": subprocess.check_output(["git", "rev-parse", "HEAD"], cwd=repo, text=True).strip(),
               "source_sha256_before": source_hashes(), "harness_invocation": sys.orig_argv,
               "environment": {"platform": platform.platform(), "python": platform.python_version(), "child_psmodulepath_removed": True},
               "tools": {name: {"sha256": sha256(tool)} for name, tool in (("ffmpeg", ffmpeg), ("ffprobe", ffprobe))},
               "fixtures": [], "cases": [], "commands": [], "references": [],
               "harness_source": Path(__file__).read_text(encoding="utf-8")}
    fixture_hashes, normal_config_hashes = {}, {}

    def require(condition, message):
        if not condition:
            raise ValueError(message)

    def run(label, command, binary=False, env=None):
        started = dt.datetime.now(dt.timezone.utc)
        process = subprocess.Popen([str(item) for item in command], cwd=repo, env=env or clean_env,
                                   stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
        timed_out = False
        try:
            stdout, stderr = process.communicate(timeout=240)
        except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
            timed_out = True
            helpers.stop_owned_process_tree(process)
            stdout, stderr = process.communicate(timeout=10)
        record = {"id": label, "command": [str(item) for item in command], "exit_code": process.returncode,
                  "timed_out": timed_out, "elapsed_seconds": round((dt.datetime.now(dt.timezone.utc) - started).total_seconds(), 3)}
        for name, data in (("stdout", stdout), ("stderr", stderr)):
            path = output / "logs" / (label + "-" + name + (".pcm" if binary and name == "stdout" else ".txt"))
            if binary and name == "stdout":
                path.write_bytes(data)
            else:
                path.write_text(sanitize(data.decode("utf-8", errors="replace")), encoding="utf-8")
            record[name + "_log"] = str(path.relative_to(repo))
            record[name + "_sha256"] = sha256(path)
        summary["commands"].append(record)
        return dict(record, stdout=stdout if binary else stdout.decode("utf-8", errors="replace"), stderr=stderr.decode("utf-8", errors="replace"))

    def checked(label, command, binary=False):
        result = run(label, command, binary)
        require(result["exit_code"] == 0 and not result["timed_out"], label + " failed")
        return result

    def inspect_audio(label, path, bits, channels, rf64=False):
        streams = json.loads(checked("probe-" + label, [ffprobe, "-v", "error", "-show_streams", "-of", "json", path])["stdout"])["streams"]
        require(len(streams) == 1, "Expected one audio stream")
        stream = streams[0]
        pcm = checked("decode-" + label, [ffmpeg, "-nostdin", "-hide_banner", "-v", "error", "-i", path,
                      "-map", "0:a:0", "-c:a", f"pcm_s{bits}le", "-f", f"s{bits}le", "-"], True)["stdout"]
        frame_bytes = bits // 8 * channels
        with path.open("rb") as source:
            container = source.read(4).decode("ascii")
        checks = {"codec": stream["codec_name"] == f"pcm_s{bits}le", "rate": int(stream["sample_rate"]) == 48000,
                  "bits": int(stream["bits_per_sample"]) == bits, "channels": stream["channels"] == channels,
                  "frames": len(pcm) == 8 * 48000 * frame_bytes, "container": container == ("RF64" if rf64 else "RIFF")}
        return dict(file_record(path), decoded_pcm_sha256=hashlib.sha256(pcm).hexdigest(), frames=len(pcm) // frame_bytes,
                    checks=checks, passed=all(checks.values()))

    def config(label, values=None, raw=None):
        path = output / "configs" / (label + ".json")
        path.write_text(raw if raw is not None else json.dumps({"schemaVersion": 1, "settings": values or {}}, ensure_ascii=False), encoding="utf-8")
        normal_config_hashes[path] = sha256(path)
        return path

    try:
        source = (repo / "WinAudioClean.ps1").read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig")
        marker = "# Explicit local support export bypasses media/dependency initialization."
        require(source.count(marker) == 1, "Capture insertion marker missing/ambiguous")
        copied_app = output / "app/WinAudioClean.ps1"
        copied_app.write_text(source.replace(marker, common.CAPTURE + marker), encoding="utf-8-sig")
        for path in source_paths[:4][1:]:
            shutil.copyfile(path, output / "app" / path.name)
        copies_before = {path.name: sha256(path) for path in (output / "app").iterdir()}
        summary["instrumentation"] = {"seam": "Ignored copy wraps native helper after import guard, before diagnostic/settings routes, and delegates unchanged; all optional siblings copied.",
                                      "insertion": common.CAPTURE, "sha256": hashlib.sha256(common.CAPTURE.encode()).hexdigest(), "copies_before": copies_before}
        for name, tool in (("ffmpeg", ffmpeg), ("ffprobe", ffprobe)):
            summary["tools"][name]["version"] = checked(name + "-version", [tool, "-version"])["stdout"].splitlines()[0]
        fixtures = {}
        for name, channels in (("stereo", 2), ("mono", 1)):
            path = output / "fixtures" / (name + ".wav")
            metadata = helpers.create_fixture(path, channels, 8, "eligible")
            summary["fixtures"].append(dict(metadata, **file_record(path)))
            fixture_hashes[path] = sha256(path)
            fixtures[name] = path
        selected = output / "fixtures/selected.mkv"
        checked("mux-selected", [ffmpeg, "-nostdin", "-hide_banner", "-v", "error", "-i", fixtures["mono"], "-i", fixtures["stereo"],
                                 "-map", "0:a:0", "-map", "1:a:0", "-c:a", "copy", selected])
        fixture_hashes[selected] = sha256(selected)
        summary["fixtures"].append(dict(file_record(selected), description="Stream0 mono and stream1 stereo; eight seconds each."))
        baseline = json.loads((repo / "docs/codex/winaudioclean/BASELINE.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig"))["filters"]
        baseline_pcm = {}
        for mode, filters in (("Raw", baseline["raw_clean"] + "," + baseline["level"]), ("Zoom", baseline["level"])):
            path = output / "references" / (mode + ".wav")
            checked("frozen-reference-" + mode, [ffmpeg, "-nostdin", "-hide_banner", "-v", "error", "-i", fixtures["stereo"], "-map", "0:0", "-vn", "-af", filters,
                    "-ar", 48000, "-c:a", "pcm_s16le", "-ac", 2, "-channel_layout", "stereo", "-map_metadata", "-1", "-map_chapters", "-1", "-f", "wav", "-rf64", "never", path])
            facts = inspect_audio("frozen-" + mode, path, 16, 2)
            summary["references"].append(facts)
            require(facts["passed"], "Frozen reference encoding failed")
            baseline_pcm[mode] = facts["decoded_pcm_sha256"]
        missing = output / "configs/absent.json"
        equivalent_cache, locale_pcm = {}, {}
        custom = {"Gate": True, "HighpassHz": 61.5, "NoiseFloorDb": -35.25, "NoiseReductionDb": 6.125, "GateThresholdDb": -40, "GateRangeDb": -20}
        for shell_name, prefix, default_culture in (("powershell.exe", "ps51", "en-US"), ("pwsh.exe", "ps7", "de-DE")):
            shell = shutil.which(shell_name)
            require(shell is not None, "Required shell missing")
            summary["environment"][prefix] = checked(prefix + "-version", [shell, "-NoLogo", "-NoProfile", "-Command", "$PSVersionTable.PSVersion.ToString()"])["stdout"].strip()

            def invoke(label, settings_path, source_path=None, flags="", destination=None, expected_exit=0, culture=None, positional=False, management=False, config_change=False, native_zero=False, expected=None):
                case_id = prefix + "-" + label
                culture = culture or default_culture
                capture = output / "captures" / case_id
                capture.mkdir()
                prior = sha256(settings_path) if settings_path.exists() else None
                invocation = "& " + common.ps_quote(copied_app) + " -SettingsPath " + common.ps_quote(settings_path)
                if source_path is not None:
                    invocation += " " + ("" if positional else "-inputPath ") + common.ps_quote(source_path)
                if destination is not None:
                    invocation += " -OutputDirectory " + common.ps_quote(destination)
                if not management:
                    invocation += " -NonInteractive -FfmpegPath " + common.ps_quote(ffmpeg) + " -FfprobePath " + common.ps_quote(ffprobe)
                invocation += " " + flags
                command = "$cultureInfo=[Globalization.CultureInfo]::GetCultureInfo(" + common.ps_quote(culture) + "); [Threading.Thread]::CurrentThread.CurrentCulture=$cultureInfo; [Threading.Thread]::CurrentThread.CurrentUICulture=$cultureInfo; Write-Host ('WAC_HARNESS_CULTURE:' + [Threading.Thread]::CurrentThread.CurrentCulture.Name); " + invocation + "; exit $LASTEXITCODE"
                result = run("app-" + case_id, [shell, "-NoLogo", "-NoProfile", "-ExecutionPolicy", "Bypass", "-Command", command], env=dict(clean_env, WAC_EVIDENCE_CAPTURE=str(capture)))
                captured = [json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig")) for path in capture.glob("*.json")]
                actual_destination = destination or (Path(expected["outputDirectory"]) if expected and "outputDirectory" in expected else None)
                audio = list(actual_destination.glob("*_Cleaned_*.wav")) if actual_destination else []
                reports = list(actual_destination.glob("WinAudioClean_*.json")) if actual_destination else []
                partials = list(actual_destination.glob(".wac-*.partial")) if actual_destination else []
                now = sha256(settings_path) if settings_path.exists() else None
                checks = {"exit": result["exit_code"] in expected_exit if isinstance(expected_exit, tuple) else result["exit_code"] == expected_exit,
                          "bounded_child": not result["timed_out"], "culture": "WAC_HARNESS_CULTURE:" + culture in result["stdout"],
                          "no_partials": not partials, "config_preserved": config_change or prior == now}
                if native_zero:
                    checks["no_native_execution"] = not captured
                if expected is None:
                    checks["no_audio_or_reports"] = not audio and not reports
                record = {"id": case_id, "culture": culture, "application_exit": result["exit_code"], "config_path": str(settings_path),
                          "config_sha256_before": prior, "config_sha256_after": now, "captured_native": captured,
                          "audio_count": len(audio), "report_count": len(reports), "checks": checks}
                if management and result["exit_code"] == 0:
                    lines = []
                    for line in result["stdout"].splitlines():
                        if line.lstrip().startswith("{"):
                            try:
                                value = json.loads(line)
                                if value.get("schemaVersion") == 1 and "settings" in value and "origins" in value:
                                    lines.append(value)
                            except ValueError:
                                pass
                    checks["one_settings_json"] = len(lines) == 1
                    if lines:
                        record["display"] = lines[0]
                if expected is not None:
                    checks["one_valid_publication"] = len(audio) == len(reports) == 1
                    if len(audio) == len(reports) == 1:
                        report = json.loads(reports[0].read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig"))
                        channels = 1 if expected.get("mono") or source_path == fixtures["mono"] or (source_path == selected and expected.get("audioStreamIndex", 0) == 0) else 2
                        facts = inspect_audio(case_id, audio[0], expected.get("bitDepth", 16), channels, expected.get("rf64", False))
                        preset = expected.get("preset", "Original")
                        options = expected.get("cleaningOptions", {})
                        mode = expected.get("mode", "Raw")
                        settings = report["settings"]
                        cleaning = None if mode == "Zoom" else dict(common.DEFAULTS[preset], **options)
                        checks["effective_report"] = settings["mode"] == mode and settings["bitDepth"] == expected.get("bitDepth", 16) and settings["loudnessMode"] == expected.get("loudnessMode", "Fast") and settings["mono"] is expected.get("mono", False) and settings["rf64"] is expected.get("rf64", False) and settings["cleaning"] == cleaning
                        checks["preset_flags"] = report["presetId"] == preset.lower() and report["presetCustomized"] is bool(options) and report["presetExperimental"] is (preset == "Gentle")
                        checks["selected_stream"] = report["input"]["stream"]["index"] == expected.get("audioStreamIndex", 0)
                        checks["report_exit"] = report["applicationExitCode"] == result["exit_code"]
                        checks["format"] = facts["passed"]
                        checks["native_selected_map"] = any("-af" in call["arguments"] and common.argument(call["arguments"], "-map") == "0:" + str(expected.get("audioStreamIndex", 0)) for call in captured)
                        record["audio"] = facts
                        record["report"] = {**file_record(reports[0]), "settings": settings, "presetId": report["presetId"], "presetVersion": report["presetVersion"], "status": report["status"], "applicationExitCode": report["applicationExitCode"], "loudnessCompliance": report["loudnessCompliance"]}
                record["passed"] = all(checks.values())
                summary["cases"].append(record)
                print(case_id + (": PASS" if record["passed"] else ": FAIL"), flush=True)
                return record

            def render_pair(label, saved_values, effective, flags="", source_path=None, culture=None, positional=False, omit_destination=False):
                source_path = source_path or fixtures["stereo"]
                destination = output / (prefix + "-" + label + "-output")
                values = dict(saved_values)
                values["outputDirectory"] = str(destination)
                prefs = config(prefix + "-" + label, values)
                result = invoke(label, prefs, source_path, flags, None if omit_destination else destination,
                                expected_exit=(0, 7), culture=culture, positional=positional, expected=dict(effective, outputDirectory=str(destination)))
                if "audio" not in result:
                    return result
                key = (prefix, str(source_path), json.dumps(effective, sort_keys=True), culture or default_culture)
                if key not in equivalent_cache:
                    cli = " -Mode " + effective.get("mode", "Raw") + " -Preset " + effective.get("preset", "Original") + " -LoudnessMode " + effective.get("loudnessMode", "Fast") + " -BitDepth " + str(effective.get("bitDepth", 16)) + " -AudioStreamIndex " + str(effective.get("audioStreamIndex", 0))
                    cli += " -Mono:$" + str(effective.get("mono", False)).lower() + " -Rf64:$" + str(effective.get("rf64", False)).lower()
                    cli += " -CleaningOptions " + common.ps_options(effective.get("cleaningOptions", {}))
                    reference = invoke(label + "-explicit-cli", missing, source_path, cli, output / (prefix + "-" + label + "-cli-output"), expected_exit=(0, 7), culture=culture, expected=effective)
                    require(reference["passed"] and "audio" in reference, "Equivalent CLI reference failed")
                    equivalent_cache[key] = reference["audio"]["decoded_pcm_sha256"]
                result["checks"]["exact_pcm_matches_explicit_cli"] = result["audio"]["decoded_pcm_sha256"] == equivalent_cache[key]
                result["passed"] = all(result["checks"].values())
                return result

            default = invoke("default-original-first", missing, fixtures["stereo"], "-Mode Raw", output / (prefix + "-default-output"), expected={"mode": "Raw"})
            if "audio" in default:
                default["checks"]["exact_frozen_original_pcm"] = default["audio"]["decoded_pcm_sha256"] == baseline_pcm["Raw"]
                default["passed"] = all(default["checks"].values())
            saved = {"mode": "Raw", "preset": "Gentle", "loudnessMode": "Accurate", "bitDepth": 24, "mono": True, "rf64": True, "cleaningOptions": {"NoiseFloorDb": -35.25, "NoiseReductionDb": 6.125}}
            render_pair("saved-mode-legacy-positional", saved, saved, positional=True, omit_destination=True)
            render_pair("cli-scalar-false-empty-overrides", saved, {"mode": "Raw"}, flags="-Preset Original -LoudnessMode Fast -BitDepth 16 -Mono:$false -Rf64:$false -CleaningOptions @{}")
            dirty = {"mode": "Raw", "preset": "Gentle", "cleaningOptions": {"Gate": True, "NoiseFloorDb": -30, "NoiseReductionDb": 4}}
            render_pair("cleaning-whole-replacement", dirty, {"mode": "Raw", "preset": "Gentle", "cleaningOptions": {"HighpassHz": 80}}, "-CleaningOptions @{HighpassHz=80}")
            render_pair("cleaning-empty-replacement", dirty, {"mode": "Raw", "preset": "Gentle"}, "-CleaningOptions @{}")
            render_pair("saved-second-stream", {"mode": "Raw", "audioStreamIndex": 1}, {"mode": "Raw", "audioStreamIndex": 1}, source_path=selected)
            render_pair("cli-stream-overrides-saved", {"mode": "Raw", "audioStreamIndex": 1}, {"mode": "Raw", "audioStreamIndex": 0}, "-AudioStreamIndex 0", source_path=selected)
            zoom = render_pair("saved-zoom", {"mode": "Zoom"}, {"mode": "Zoom"})
            if "audio" in zoom:
                zoom["checks"]["exact_frozen_zoom_pcm"] = zoom["audio"]["decoded_pcm_sha256"] == baseline_pcm["Zoom"]
                zoom["passed"] = all(zoom["checks"].values())
            for culture in ("de-DE", "fi-FI"):
                effective = {"mode": "Raw", "preset": "Gentle", "bitDepth": 24, "cleaningOptions": custom}
                result = render_pair("saved-fractional-" + culture, effective, effective, culture=culture)
                if "audio" in result:
                    if culture in locale_pcm:
                        result["checks"]["exact_pcm_across_shells"] = locale_pcm[culture] == result["audio"]["decoded_pcm_sha256"]
                        result["passed"] = all(result["checks"].values())
                    locale_pcm[culture] = result["audio"]["decoded_pcm_sha256"]
            invoke("unattended-missing-mode", missing, fixtures["stereo"], destination=output / (prefix + "-missing-mode"), expected_exit=2, native_zero=True)
            invoke("unattended-ambiguous-stream", missing, selected, "-Mode Raw", output / (prefix + "-ambiguous"), expected_exit=2)
            malformed = config(prefix + "-malformed", raw='{"schemaVersion":1,"settings":')
            invoke("malformed-cli-cannot-repair", malformed, fixtures["stereo"], "-Mode Raw -BitDepth 16", output / (prefix + "-bad-json"), expected_exit=2, native_zero=True)
            wrong_type = config(prefix + "-wrong-type", {"mode": "Raw", "bitDepth": "24"})
            invoke("wrong-type-cli-cannot-repair", wrong_type, fixtures["stereo"], "-Mode Raw -BitDepth 16", output / (prefix + "-bad-type"), expected_exit=2, native_zero=True)
            version = config(prefix + "-unknown-version", raw='{"schemaVersion":2,"settings":{}}')
            invoke("unknown-schema", version, fixtures["stereo"], "-Mode Raw", output / (prefix + "-bad-version"), expected_exit=2, native_zero=True)
            combo = config(prefix + "-invalid-combo", {"mode": "Zoom", "preset": "Gentle"})
            invoke("saved-combo-cli-cannot-repair", combo, fixtures["stereo"], "-Mode Raw -Preset Original -CleaningOptions @{}", output / (prefix + "-bad-combo"), expected_exit=2, native_zero=True)
            injected = config(prefix + "-filter-text", {"mode": "Raw", "cleaningOptions": {"FilterChain": "volume=0"}})
            invoke("arbitrary-filter-rejected", injected, fixtures["stereo"], "-Mode Raw", output / (prefix + "-bad-filter"), expected_exit=2, native_zero=True)
            ignored = invoke("ignore-invalid-file", malformed, fixtures["stereo"], "-IgnoreSavedSettings -Mode Raw", output / (prefix + "-ignore-output"), expected={"mode": "Raw"})
            if "audio" in ignored:
                ignored["checks"]["exact_frozen_original_pcm"] = ignored["audio"]["decoded_pcm_sha256"] == baseline_pcm["Raw"]
                ignored["passed"] = all(ignored["checks"].values())
            reset = invoke("reset-malformed-no-input", malformed, flags="-ResetSettings -ShowSettings", management=True, config_change=True, native_zero=True)
            reset["checks"]["empty_reset_file"] = json.loads(malformed.read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig")) == {"schemaVersion": 1, "settings": {}}
            reset["passed"] = all(reset["checks"].values())
            normal_config_hashes[malformed] = sha256(malformed)
            after_reset = invoke("post-reset-builtins", malformed, fixtures["stereo"], "-Mode Raw", output / (prefix + "-reset-output"), expected={"mode": "Raw"})
            if "audio" in after_reset:
                after_reset["checks"]["exact_frozen_original_pcm"] = after_reset["audio"]["decoded_pcm_sha256"] == baseline_pcm["Raw"]
                after_reset["passed"] = all(after_reset["checks"].values())
            saved_path = output / "configs" / (prefix + "-save-managed.json")
            save_destination = output / (prefix + "-save-destination")
            save_flags = "-SaveSettings -ShowSettings -Mode Raw -Preset Gentle -BitDepth 24 -Mono:$false -Rf64:$false -CleaningOptions " + common.ps_options(custom) + " -OutputDirectory " + common.ps_quote(save_destination)
            save = invoke("save-show-no-input", saved_path, flags=save_flags, management=True, config_change=True, native_zero=True)
            stored = json.loads(saved_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig"))
            save["stored_settings"] = stored
            save["checks"]["typed_saved_values"] = stored["schemaVersion"] == 1 and stored["settings"]["mode"] == "Raw" and stored["settings"]["preset"] == "Gentle" and stored["settings"]["bitDepth"] == 24 and stored["settings"]["mono"] is False and stored["settings"]["rf64"] is False and stored["settings"]["cleaningOptions"] == custom
            save["checks"]["output_not_created_by_management"] = not save_destination.exists()
            save["passed"] = all(save["checks"].values())
            normal_config_hashes[saved_path] = sha256(saved_path)
            show = invoke("show-precedence-no-input", saved_path, flags="-ShowSettings -BitDepth 16 -Mono:$false -CleaningOptions @{}", management=True, native_zero=True)
            if "display" in show:
                display = show["display"]
                show["checks"]["resolved_display"] = display["settings"]["bitDepth"] == 16 and display["settings"]["mono"] is False and display["settings"]["cleaningOptions"] == {}
                show["checks"]["reported_origins"] = display["origins"]["Mode"] == "Saved" and display["origins"]["BitDepth"] == "CLI" and display["origins"]["CleaningOptions"] == "CLI"
            show["passed"] = all(show["checks"].values())
            invoke("save-reset-exclusive", saved_path, flags="-SaveSettings -ResetSettings", expected_exit=2, management=True, native_zero=True)
            invoke("reset-processing-choice-rejected", saved_path, flags="-ResetSettings -Mode Raw", expected_exit=2, management=True, native_zero=True)
            invoke("management-input-rejected", saved_path, source_path=fixtures["stereo"], flags="-ShowSettings", expected_exit=2, management=True, native_zero=True)
        summary["fixtures_unchanged"] = all(sha256(path) == digest for path, digest in fixture_hashes.items())
